'''TX-840''' was a [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] who served the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{RPG}}
In about [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], TX-840 was among a group of Imperials that escorted [[General/Legends|General]] [[Sebastian Parnell]] to the [[Deathblock]], a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] block located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tol Ado]]. On arrival at the Deathblock, the Imperials noticed that some of the facility's guards had been [[Death/Legends|killed]], so Parnell ordered TX-840 to defend the position.
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
TX-840 was created by [[Troy Denning]] and appeared in one of the [[Roleplaying game|role-playing]] strands of the [[1990]] [[West End Games]] role-playing supplement ''[[Jedi's Honor]]''.

==Appearances==
*''[[Jedi's Honor]]'' {{1st}}
